label: Essential power and the scope of underivedness
summary: External grounding of possession supports dependence in the selected power. Inseparability of a power from its bearer does not determine explanatory direction. A constitutive argument would need the externally grounded actuality to partly ground the bearer's existence and partial grounding to compose. Existing power and exercise controls are scope anchors, not proofs of that lift. See docs/notes/borrowed-exercise-741.md.
blocker: Defend the constitutive premise for the selected power and map the resulting dependence to the root route's selected existential grounding relation.
